articles.title: Mouse fight club might explain why we like to watch violent things
articles.summary:
There’s something about watching violent events that broadly appeals to us, whether it’s the latest John Wick movie, a video game, or a live UFC bout. Scientists have debated whether watching violent things could make us more aggressive, but it could also be an adaptive survival strategy. Male mice, for instance, who watched other mice fighting learned enough about how to fight to better protect themselves (compared to mice who didn’t watch fights) when pitted against stronger, more aggressive opponents, according to a paper published in the journal Nature.
The team randomly assigned male mice to three groups—fighters, spectators, or novices—and then subjected each group to eight days of training with three 10-minute sessions per day. The novices played with stuffed mice in isolation, while the spectators watched various pairs of fighter mice battle from a raised platform behind a transparent barrier—a set-up chosen to let them smell and listen to the fights as well as observe them.
The ninth day was “fight night,” when all the mice had to face a daunting opponent in three 4-minute rounds. Each fight was filmed from above so that the mouse behavior could be analyzed. To monitor corresponding changes in brain activity, the team engineered the rodents’ excitatory brain cells to glow green whenever they were activated, while inhibitory brain cells glowed red. De ahí que quisiera desarrollar un dispositivo que ayudara a regar. Con él ha ganado una medalla de oro juvenil en la feria de inventos de Núremberg con solo 14 años.
Tiene su origen en un momento en el que su madre estaba cocinando. Vio cómo el vapor formaba gotas de agua en los azulejos. Conocido en el mundo de los mercados bajo las siglas BTC, el bitcoin utiliza la criptografía para garantizar que su gestión sea descentralizada, es decir, que no pueda ser regulado por ninguna institución u organismo bancario, lo que a su vez hace que las criptomonedas sean volátiles.

- Computación. Anthropic se ha comprometido a gastar unos 900.000 millones de dólares en infraestructura. Al menos 121.300 millones irán a Google y al menos 110.000 a Amazon. En el tercer trimestre, la computación se ha llevado el 58% de sus ingresos.

Entre líneas. Sus acciones son de clase N y no tienen voto. articles.title: 98,3 % de victoires : la puce quantique de Google pulvérise un plafond logique classique
articles.summary:
La mécanique quantique a une centaine d’années, et son interprétation continue de diviser les physiciens, tandis que ses propriétés restent difficiles à comprendre. Albert Einstein, lui, se demandait si la Lune est bien là quand personne ne la regarde : c’était sa façon de défendre l’idée que les propriétés physiques existent avant qu’on les mesure.
Google Quantum AI, la division de recherche quantique de Google, s’est justement penchée sur l’une de ces propriétés. L’étude est cosignée par l’un de ses membres, le Français Michel Devoret, prix Nobel de physique 2025. Cette propriété, la « contextualité quantique », est moins connue que l’intrication quantique, même si l’expérience de Google s’appuie aussi sur des qubits intriqués.
Qu’est-ce que la contextualité ? En termes simples, le résultat d’une mesure dépend des autres mesures compatibles faites en même temps, c’est-à-dire de son « contexte ». On ne peut donc pas supposer que les valeurs étaient fixées à l’avance. L’équipe publie ses résultats dans la revue Science, après les avoir mis en ligne en prépublication sur arXiv en décembre 2025.
Google a mené ses expériences sur ses puces quantiques Willow. L’entreprise dit avoir mesuré cette contextualité jusqu’à 105 qubits (les unités de calcul d’un ordinateur quantique). Or, jusqu’ici, on ne l’avait guère observée que sur des systèmes plus petits, ne mobilisant que quelques particules.
Pour le montrer, Google a utilisé le jeu du carré magique. Il s’agit de remplir une grille…

articles.title: Inside Amazon Connect Talent: The science of structured AI interviews | Amazon Web Services
articles.summary:
Artificial Intelligence
Inside Amazon Connect Talent: The science of structured AI interviews
For organizations hiring hundreds or thousands of people, every interview presents the same challenge: How do you give candidates a consistent opportunity to demonstrate their skills while gathering the evidence needed to make informed hiring decisions?
Structured behavioral interviews offer a research-backed approach to this challenge. They use consistent, job-related questions and clear scoring criteria to give candidates an opportunity to demonstrate their skills. Decades of research in industrial-organizational (I-O) psychology have shown that structured interviews help organizations evaluate candidates and predict job performance (Schmidt & Hunter, 1998; Sackett et al., 2022). Blue Origin announced Thursday that its New Glenn rocket will launch data center satellites for Google in 2029 as part of that company’s Project Suncatcher program.
Google disclosed it was working on scalable orbiting data centers about a year ago and characterized the project as one of its research “moonshots.” The mission on New Glenn is designed to deploy satellites, each with computing capacity at roughly the scale of a data center rack, into Sun-synchronous orbit where they can receive nearly continuous solar energy.
“Project Suncatcher is a long-term moonshot to scale AI infrastructure in space by tapping into the abundant solar power in orbit,” said Travis Beals, senior director of Project Suncatcher at Google, in the news release. “This dedicated launch with Blue Origin represents a crucial milestone on our roadmap as we expand the boundaries of what’s possible for the future of compute.”
Catching a ride while they still can

Memory pooling is fast becoming one of the sharpest tools in AI inference economics, with companies racing to wring more output from every graphics processing unit.

“Our core fundamental technology is around pooling and sharing the most critical resources in the data center, which are now GPU and memory,” Puri said. “Rather than statically deploying these things inside of a server, our vision is simple. If true, the vulnerability means even BitLocker won't help keep users' files protected.

articles.title: App de enfermería envía trabajadores sin orientación: un caso terminó con la muerte de un usuario
articles.summary:
Una investigación de WIRED y Proof News concluyó que ShiftKey, una aplicación que funciona como un Uber para el sector de enfermería, envía trabajadores independientes a hogares de ancianos de Estados Unidos con poca o ninguna orientación, lo que derivó en errores graves, según documentos judiciales e informes de inspección federales.
La plataforma, fundada en 2016 en Texas, reúne a más de 200.000 trabajadores de salud y a más de 10.000 centros. Los medios analizaron 108.706 turnos publicados en marzo, julio y agosto de 2026: el 89 por ciento correspondía a hogares de ancianos, y la mayoría pedía enfermeros auxiliares o prácticos.
El caso más grave es el de Emma Lewis, de 93 años. En mayo de 2022, la enfermera práctica Felicia Kaye le inyectó la insulina de su compañera de cuarto en el centro Peachtree. Lewis fue llevada a un hospital y murió 12 días después.
Kaye no era empleada del centro: había tomado el turno por la aplicación. Declaró en agosto que nunca recibió orientación y que solo le entregaron las llaves del carro de medicamentos. Era la única enfermera a cargo de un piso con 22 pacientes y había manejado más de 400 kilómetros para llegar.
ShiftKey sostuvo en el juicio que no es responsable porque Kaye nunca fue su empleada, y pagará USD 40.000 para llegar a un acuerdo con la familia. El centro Peachtree alegó que no responde por los actos de un contratista independiente y destacó que Lewis tenía otras enfermedades. Su certificado de defunción menciona una degenerac…

articles.title: Google affirme que Gemini consomme très peu d’eau, mais la réalité est plus complexe
articles.summary:
Selon Google, une requête adressée à Gemini ne consommerait que 5 gouttes d’eau. Mais ce chiffre ne tient pas compte d’un élément important.
Google est aux petits soins pour Gemini. Ses équipes ont récemment intégré l’agent Spark dans l’application Android de l’IA. Elles ont également déployé un nouveau modèle, Gemini 4 Argon, pour damer le pion à OpenAI et Anthropic et amélioré ses fonctions de synthèse vocale avec Gemini 3.8. Mais toutes ces évolutions ont un coût environnemental qu’il ne faut pas négliger.
Gemini ne consommerait que 5 gouttes d’eau par requête
Nos confrères de TechRadar se sont récemment penchés sur la consommation d’eau de Gemini : une étude technique publiée en août 2025 par Google indique à ce sujet qu’une requête ne consommerait que 0,24 Wh d’énergie et rejetterait 0,03g d’équivalent CO2. « L'impact énergétique par commande équivaut à regarder la télévision pendant moins de neuf secondes », peut-on notamment lire. Quant à la consommation d’eau, elle équivaudrait à seulement 0,26 millilitres d'eau soit 5 petites gouttes d’eau.
Mieux encore, Google se targue d’avoir divisé l’empreinte énergétique d’une requête par 33 en un an et son empreinte carbone par 44 tout en augmentant l’efficacité de ses modèles. « Nous sommes convaincus qu’il s’agit de l’évaluation la plus complète de cet impact », précise également la firme. Tout irait donc pour le mieux dans le meilleur des mondes.

Agentic AI pushes the neocloud race beyond GPU counts toward global platforms
The neocloud boom is entering a sorting phase, and global cloud availability is emerging as the line between providers built for enterprise AI and those built to rent out racks of graphics processing units.
With agentic AI moving from pilots into production, buyers are looking past raw GPU counts toward integrated platforms they can build on. That shift is redrawing the competitive map for cloud AI infrastructure. Enterprise practitioners are now starting ambitious agentic AI agendas, and they need the full stack of services behind AI-native applications rather than standalone clusters, according to Kevin Cochrane (pictured, right), chief marketing officer of Vultr.
“There are those providers that are trusted platforms, that are global cloud platforms that have the totality of services that are required for real agentic AI deployments,” Cochrane said. “We’ll continue to see a separation of the pack and there’ll be those that are trusted platforms that enterprises can rely on and there’ll be those that aren’t.”

articles.title: MAHA PAC spent more on steak, luxury club than candidates, report shows
articles.summary:
In the wake of the Make America Healthy Again movement’s midterm wipeout, a top leader suggested the heavy losses came down to being outspent by wealthier, more powerful rivals. But a Stat report on MAHA’s own spending in the run-up to the election raises questions about whether the group’s priority was ever winning elections in the first place.
The dive into the financial documents reveals that the MAHA PAC, led by Tony Lyons, spent more on allies, boosters, meals, luxuries, and its affiliated nonprofit than it did on political candidates.
The findings are in stark contrast to an announcement from Lyons in the spring that he was heading a $100 million fundraiser to boost MAHA’s clout in the midterms. In reality, MAHA PAC took in $3.2 million. During the election cycle, the PAC spent more than $10.5 million, with over $7 million coming from money it had collected previously.
According to Stat’s findings, of the $10.5 million the MAHA PAC spent on the midterms, less than a tenth—roughly $1 million—went to messaging on political candidates, which are expenses called “independent expenditures.”
Andrew Mayersohn, a committees researcher at OpenSecrets, called the spending “pretty unusual,” explaining that “Major super PACs spend most of their money on independent expenditures.”
MAHA perks

articles.title: Gartner Warns of Risks Behind Sovereign Tech Claims - EE Times
articles.summary:
BARCELONA, Spain — Addressing enterprise and government executives at the recent Gartner IT Symposium/Xpo, Gartner analysts René Buest and Bettina Tratz-Ryan delivered a critical assessment of Europe’s campaign for digital autonomy. They warned that commercial promises of “sovereign” technology frequently amount to marketing maneuvers that leave organizations exposed to foreign jurisdiction and operational disruption.
Reinforced by Gartner research predicting that digital sovereignty will become a core component of national security strategies globally by 2030, and that over 90% of European Union organizations will adopt a sovereignty strategy by 2029, the sessions underscored an acute policy dilemma: European institutions seeking autonomy remain bound to foreign cloud giants, proprietary platforms, and offshore semiconductor manufacturing.
“As dependency risks rise, sovereignty is shifting from a question of location to an economic and operational survivability imperative,” Buest said during a conference session titled “Sovereignty Washing: How to Challenge Your Sovereign Vendor.” He added that “dependencies that once delivered efficiency must now be treated as potential business continuity risks.”

articles.title: Já há mais satélites visíveis a olho nu do que estrelas em várias regiões • Tecnoblog
articles.summary:
Já há mais satélites visíveis a olho nu do que estrelas em várias regiões
Rastros de satélites já são muito visíveis em grande parte da Europa e nos Estados Unidos.
Um estudo realizado pela empresa de engenharia Accu acende um alerta para um fenômeno cada vez mais perceptível: em muitos pontos do planeta, já há mais satélites artificiais cruzando o céu do que estrelas visíveis a olho nu. A causa é um tanto óbvia: o número crescente de satélites de órbita baixa direcionados a serviços de internet, com destaque para as unidades da Starlink.
A pesquisa foi baseada em dados levantados entre 12 e 18 de outubro deste ano. Esses dados fazem parte de um sistema de monitoramento de satélites disponibilizados pela Força Espacial dos Estados Unidos no site CelesTrak.
No período em questão, os pesquisadores da Accu analisaram as trajetórias de 15.833 satélites artificiais que operam em órbita baixa — em linhas gerais, aqueles que estão a até 2.000 km de altitude.
O estudo constatou que, em média, 710 satélites atravessavam o céu de uma cidade britânica de latitude intermediária à noite, considerando o horizonte completamente desobstruído. Destes, uma média de 105 satélites poderiam ser vistos a olho nu porque estavam refletindo a luz do Sol, brilhando tanto ou mais do que as estrelas.
Este é, de fato, um ponto de atenção, pois satélites artificiais não emitem luz própria. Eles podem ser notados à noite, ao entardecer ou ao amanhecer porque refletem a luz solar.

articles.title: On a débridé GTA 6 à 60 FPS : Vice City n’a jamais été aussi fluide
articles.summary:
À quoi ressemblerait Vice City à 60 images par seconde ? On a sorti le boîtier de capture pour vous en donner un aperçu, à partir de notre propre partie sur PS5 Pro.
Pour se faire une idée de la fluidité d’un jeu, rien de tel qu’un bon coup de stick. La caméra pivote, les façades défilent et, pour peu qu’on ait l’habitude de jouer à 60 images par seconde, on se prend à chercher le mode Performance dans les réglages. Dans GTA VI, on peut chercher longtemps. Rockstar a choisi de viser les 30 images par seconde, y compris sur PS5 Pro. Alors on a tenté une petite expérience avec les moyens du bord. Voici ce que donne notre partie une fois les images passées entre les mains d’un PC.

De acuerdo a diferentes publicaciones, se han encontrado más de 170 animales en las primeras horas del videojuego, aunque el catálogo completo todavía no se conoce. La fauna se distribuye por ciudades, zonas rurales, playas y humedales.
Entre los animales terrestres figuran caimanes, ciervos, perros, gatos, mapaches, nutrias, zorros, iguanas y serpientes. También se encuentran especies asociadas con Florida, como el manatí y la pantera de Florida. Los caimanes destacan por aparecer en lugares muy distintos, incluidos espacios urbanos y zonas cercanas a viviendas.
La diversidad de especies hace que los encuentros cambien según el lugar que se visite. En la ciudad pueden aparecer mascotas y animales callejeros; en los pantanos y el campo, la fauna silvestre ocupa un lugar más visible. Las zonas costeras y las aguas abiertas, por su parte, reúnen animales marinos.
Aves y animales marinos de Leonida
La lista recopilada incluye flamencos, pelícanos, garzas, gaviotas, patos, cormoranes, grullas y espátulas. Se calcula que habrá más de 60 tipos de aves en el juego. Estas especies forman parte de los distintos paisajes y ayudan a diferenciar, por ejemplo, las zonas húmedas de las playas y los espacios urbanos.

Pausa indefinida. Estados Unidos es el mercado más grande de Waymo actualmente, y se suponía que las autopistas iban a ser el siguiente paso en la expansión de la firma. Enterprises pushing AI from pilot to production are learning that data, not GPUs, is the hardest part, and open table formats such as Apache Iceberg are part of the answer. Demand for AI infrastructure shows few signs of slowing, but much of the information companies need is still scattered, ungoverned and out of reach.
That pressure is turning storage into an active layer that classifies, governs and serves data to models. Unstructured files such as logs and medical images hold intelligence AI can now extract, according to Arun Prasad Raman (pictured, left), vice president of hybrid cloud and AI infrastructure at Hitachi Vantara Corp.
“Storage is not seen as just storing the data,” Raman said. “You need to bring in more intelligence natively rather than moving the data to another replication and bringing it back for, say, indexing. If it can do it natively, that’s where the value add is.”

También se buscarán aquellos que aíslen mejor de las temperaturas extremas, tanto altas como bajas. Por eso, unos ingenieros han estado buscando alternativas hasta dar con una propuesta interesante: usar el material de las mantas de emergencia.
Capas apiladas de Mylar. Las mantas de emergencia están hechas con BoPET (tereftalato de polietileno orientado biaxialmente), un material conocido comercialmente como Mylar, que se obtiene estirando el PET clásico en dos direcciones. Así, se consigue una lámina mucho más fina y resistente. Pero no solo es resistente. Si se le añade aluminio, refleja muy bien la radiación infrarroja, por lo que se convierte en un aislante térmico ideal. Esa es justamente la razón por la que esta combinación se usa para fabricar mantas de emergencia, como las que se emplean para tapar a corredores de maratón tras un ejercicio extremo o a las víctimas de un accidente o desastre natural.

Nvidia Corp. reported its quarterly results this week, and contrary to the prevailing narrative, the sky didn’t fall.
Revenue more than doubled year-over-year. The Vera Rubin chip platform achieved the fastest product ramp in the company’s history, and management raised its fiscal 2028 growth outlook to roughly 75%, up from 70%. By all accounts, it was a solid beat and raise.
This was Nvidia’s first earnings call without co-founder Jensen Huang, whose resignation as president and chief executive was announced on Nov. 12. Board Chair Harvey Jones told investors that the resignation followed the “disclosure of personal behavior inconsistent with the company’s code of conduct, standards, and cultural norms.” Hours after Huang publicly said he would be willing to return, Jones said the board “does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO” and would not take questions about the circumstances or the board’s ongoing investigation.

AMD "Zen 6" for Desktop Reportedly Pushed to Computex 2027
AMD's upcoming Ryzen processors based on the new "Zen 6" core architecture are reportedly delayed until Computex 2027, according to the latest information from Chiphell. The "Zen 6" EPYC lineup will utilize TSMC's N2 node, with the standard version for "Venice" and the enhanced N2P for "Verano." However, for the desktop "Zen 6" Ryzen family, codenamed "Olympic Ridge," AMD is switching to TSMC's N2X node, an enhanced variant of the standard N2 that targets higher frequencies. This switch results in delayed mass production and rollout of desktop Ryzen. TSMC plans to begin mass production of its N2X node in 2027, meaning "Olympic Ridge" will likely arrive a few months later, with Computex 2027 being the probable announcement date.
AMD likely chose the N2X node for its higher clock potential. Originally, TSMC targeted HPC workloads, but desktop processors can also benefit from high clock speeds for maximum performance. The N2X node offers two advantages over the standard N2: an ultra-high performance standard cell that delivers a 5% higher clock speed, and a high-speed device, which provides an additional 5% boost, resulting in a combined 10% speed increase.For CES 2027, AMD is likely preparing one of its mobile "Zen 6" SoCs from the "Medusa" family. articles.title: Enterprise AI infrastructure moves beyond GPUs - SiliconANGLE
articles.summary:
Enterprise AI is pushing cloud infrastructure beyond the GPU
Enterprise adoption of artificial intelligence is creating new requirements for enterprise AI infrastructure. While much of the early AI investment centered on access to powerful GPUs, organizations moving AI applications and agents into production are discovering that accelerators are only one part of the equation.
Agentic AI systems need environments where they can execute code, access data, connect to enterprise applications and operate securely across distributed infrastructure. That requires more than bare-metal GPU capacity. It calls for a complete cloud platform that combines compute, networking, storage, security and the services needed to manage applications at scale.
That shift is creating an opportunity for neocloud providers, but it is also changing what enterprises expect from them. Infrastructure providers increasingly need to support the full application lifecycle rather than simply supply specialized hardware.
During a live interview at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America 2026, theCUBE Research’s Paul Nashawaty spoke with Kevin Cochrane, chief marketing officer at Vultr, about the changing requirements of enterprise AI infrastructure, the return of CPU-based computing, data sovereignty and the growing role of platform engineering.
“They need a full cloud platform,” Cochrane said. “They need cloud compute, specialized AI compute, networking, storage and an open ecosystem.”

Medical AI startup Boltz raises $110M to speed up small molecule research
Boltz PBC, a startup that develops artificial intelligence models for pharmaceutical researchers, has raised $110 million in funding.
Bessemer led the Series A investment. Boltz stated on Wednesday that the fund was joined by a large group of new and returning backers. The consortium included Greycroft, Andreessen Horowitz, Amplify Partners, F-Prime Capital, Hummingbird and others.
Small molecules, the building blocks of many drugs, can only neutralize a pathogen after binding to it. As a result, researchers start drug discovery projects by looking for molecules that have a high binding affinity with pathogens. They often review hundreds of thousands of candidate molecules per project. The process can take months and often costs millions of dollars.
Boltz offers an AI model called BoltzMol-1 that speeds up the workflow. It generates binding affinity data by reviewing only a few dozen, particularly promising molecules instead of the hundreds of thousands usually needed. The fewer molecules need to be studied, the less time the analysis takes.
Binding affinity evaluations don’t yield drug discoveries right away. Instead, they produce data points called small molecule hits. Those are essentially faint clues that help researchers pinpoint the area where they should focus their efforts.

articles.title: NAND Spot Prices Slide 20% in Weeks as Consumer Demand Dries Up
articles.summary:
Thursday, November 19th 2026
NAND Spot Prices Slide 20% in Weeks as Consumer Demand Dries Up
NAND flash appears to be finally getting cheaper, at least on the spot market. According to the Seoul Economic Daily, spot prices for NAND flash have dropped roughly 20% since the second half of October. TrendForce says the drop in price took just two weeks, as Chinese traders dumped inventory. A 512 Gb wafer now goes for about $14.30, which is 32% below last quarter, and 1 Tb products are down 19% to $24.90. Apparently, the reasoning is weak consumer demand, since buyers are now delaying upgrades due to high prices. Moreover, phone manufacturers are trimming base storage specs, and PC makers are selling through their existing stock as shipments continue to fall.
That's the spot side of the story, but contract prices run on long-term deals and have been slower to react. Bank of America reportedly expects smartphone and PC NAND contract prices to fall 5-10% QoQ in Q1 2027, while enterprise products are expected to hold flat or slightly creep up. TrendForce also expects overall NAND contract prices to slip 0-5% in Q2 2027. In light of all these predictions, it looks like there is some relief on the horizon as far as NAND prices go. That's a turnaround from early reports that predicted the shortage would last at least three more years. However, now it looks like SSD prices will continue to fall slowly but surely into 2027, at least on the consumer side.

Oxford experts make the case for thinking of AI as ‘feral’
“A horde of AI agents conspired against their creators,” cried a recent headline of an article published in The Economist.
“‘We’re plausibly close to crossing the line’: are warnings of uncontrollable AI coming true?” the Guardian asked just a few days later.
These are just some of the many alarming front-page news stories which have emerged after an autonomous AI agent in Open AI’s training recently breached Hugging Face, an American company based in New York City that develops computation tools for building applications using machine learning.
However, despite what these headlines suggest, the future is not necessarily doomed. As our Oxford colleague Ciaran Martin recently wrote in the Economist, “fears of AI-induced cyber-Armageddon are overdone”.
Jerome Ravetz, Affiliate of the Institute for Science, Innovation and Society (InSIS), University of Oxford; Lukas Zumbrunn, Oxford-Hyundai Motor Group Foresight Centre, Saïd Business School, University of Oxford; Rafael Ramirez, Oxford-Hyundai Motor Group Foresight Centre, Saïd Business School, University of Oxford
Still, it’s true that the unprecedented way in which AI agents have coordinated and communicated raises novel, radical uncertainties. How concerned should we be? articles.title: La agencia migratoria ICE paga a AT&T por acceder a registros de llamadas sin aprobación de un juez
articles.summary:
El Servicio de Inmigración y Control de Aduanas de Estados Unidos (ICE) paga a la operadora AT&T para que sus analistas revisen datos telefónicos en bruto en una amplia variedad de investigaciones. Lo reveló 404 Media a partir de un documento interno de ICE. Especialistas en privacidad lo describen como un programa de vigilancia masiva.
El documento, obtenido mediante un pedido de acceso a información pública, dice que el contrato da a ICE “acceso a los datos en bruto de AT&T y a analistas con experiencia”. Los analistas convierten esos datos a un formato utilizable para las investigaciones de Seguridad Nacional (HSI, por su sigla en inglés), la rama de ICE que investiga delitos.
Los registros públicos de contratación indican que ICE pagó a AT&T más de USD 2,1 millones en 2025 y más de USD 2,2 millones en agosto de este año. El contrato puede superar los USD 10 millones en los próximos años, según 404 Media.
El texto sostiene que en el año fiscal 2025 aumentó la demanda de estos datos y que se prevé “un nuevo aumento significativo”. También afirma que AT&T es el único proveedor con acceso a sus propios datos: si la empresa no hace el análisis, “la capacidad se perderá”.

articles.title: Una pistola fabricada en Argentina apareció en GTA VI: qué dijo el CEO de la empresa sobre la referencia
articles.summary:
Una pistola que remite a un modelo producido en Argentina apareció entre las armas de GTA VI, el último lanzamiento de una de las sagas más populares de la industria de los videojuegos. La referencia no lleva el nombre ni la marca de la empresa, pero una pieza similar a la Bersa Thunder 380 quedó asociada a la Scorpio Nipper .38 dentro del juego, a partir de los mensajes que recibió la compañía.
Para Manuel Pizarro, CEO de Bersa, el hallazgo fue inesperado. La fábrica argentina no había sido consultada ni había intervenido en la inclusión del arma, ya que el videojuego no identifica al modelo con su denominación comercial. “Nos sorprendimos ayer con esto porque no lo sabíamos”, afirmó el directivo en Infobae Al Mediodía.
La asociación surgió por la apariencia del arma y no por un acuerdo entre la empresa y los desarrolladores de GTA VI, explicó Pizarro. Dentro de la trama, el arma se llama Scorpio Nipper .38, una denominación ficticia que, según señalaron los conductores del programa, reúne rasgos de la Thunder 380 fabricada por Bersa.
Pizarro remarcó que la ausencia de la marca explica por qué no hubo un pedido de autorización. La compañía no recibió consultas previas sobre su presencia en el juego ni confirmó si buscará comunicarse con los responsables del título después de conocer la referencia visual.

articles.summary:
Thursday, November 19th 2026
Windows 7 Gets Unofficial DirectX 12 Support for Modern GPUs
Windows 7 was a beloved operating system for many, and if you're still running a machine with that OS, this release might be for you. Three Windows 7 enthusiasts have managed to get current-generation GPUs and DirectX 12 running on Microsoft's 17-year-old OS. Bob Pony shared the project on X, called WDDM2Win7, an unofficial backport of the Windows Display Driver Model (WDDM) 2. The screenshots show Intel UHD Graphics 770, an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060, and an AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT, all detected in TechPowerUp's GPU-Z and running in Windows 7. According to the developer, GeForce RTX 40-series and 50-series cards, as well as Radeon RX 7000 and RX 9000 series cards, work. Intel UHD and Xe graphics are also supported, and DirectX 12 works as well.
Windows 7 originally shipped with WDDM 1.1, while WDDM 2.0 arrived alongside Windows 10 in 2015, bringing DirectX 12 along with it. Microsoft then brought DirectX 12 to Windows 7 in 2019, though only as a user-mode runtime. Individual games like World of Warcraft had to ship it themselves, which limited compatibility. The developers behind this project also backported the Steam client beta to Windows 7 last December after Valve dropped support for the OS in early 2024. - F5 patches multiple NGINX vulnerabilities, including two critical flaws that could enable unauthenticated remote code execution
- The bugs affect widely deployed internet infrastructure and prompted an out-of-band security release
- Organizations are urged to upgrade to NGINX 1.31.9 immediately, especially when HTTP/2 is enabled
We can add NGINX to the growing list of crucial software containing critical severity vulnerabilities that need urgent patching.
F5 has published an out-of-band security notification addressing 10 flaws in NGINX, including two that allow unauthenticated threat actors to launch arbitrary code on the servers, remotely.
Who the what now?
NGINX is an open source web server software owned by F5, and used to deliver websites and web applications to users. It can also act as a reverse proxy, load balancer, and HTTP cache, helping websites handle large amounts of traffic more efficiently.
The tool is often found on web servers and cloud infrastructure where it’s installed between users’ browsers and the applications or services hosting a website.
It is one of the most widely deployed web server technologies in the world. Approximately 73 million websites use NGINX according to WebAtla’s November 20…

articles.title: PHP Warns of Critical Security Flaws Affecting All Supported Versions, Fixes Coming November 19
articles.summary:
The maintainers of the PHP programming language on Wednesday issued an advisory announcing an upcoming security release that addresses critical flaws.
The release is scheduled for November 19, 2026, between 2 and 2:30 p.m. UTC.
"These releases are part of PHP's regular four-week release cycle and will address security vulnerabilities affecting all supported PHP versions," the maintainers said. "The highest severity is CRITICAL."
However, the project also noted that issues rated critical require either non-default configuration or uncommon setups. It did not disclose any additional specifics.
The update is expected to include CVE-2026-115560, a remote code execution flaw that succeeds only if the following conditions are met -
- An application sets session.serialize_handler to php_binary or php_serialize in its configuration, and its code switches the handler to php with ini_set() before calling session_start().
- Session upload progress is enabled, which is PHP's default.
As mitigations, users were urged to set session.upload_progress.enabled=0 until the next regular bugfix release and restart the PHP worker for the setting to be applied.
The development comes nearly a month after PHP released fixes for two critical vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, collectively tracked as PHP2Shell that enable unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) via specially crafted HTTP requests.

articles.title: Google Play va bloquer les apps non adaptées aux pliables et tablettes Android dès avril 2027
articles.summary:
À partir d’avril 2027, les applications qui ne respectent pas un niveau minimal de compatibilité avec les grands écrans ne pourront plus être publiées ni mises à jour sur le Play Store. Les jeux auront quatre mois de délai supplémentaire.
Google passe de l’incitation à l’obligation. Depuis Android 12L, en 2022, la firme encourageait les développeurs à adapter leurs applications aux grands écrans, mais Sammobile juge que la progression est restée trop lente. Le lancement de l’iPhone Duo, a servi de déclencheur : Google ne veut plus laisser les éditeurs avancer à leur rythme.
Un plancher « Tier 3 » imposé dès avril 2027
Le dispositif repose sur trois niveaux de qualité adaptative. Le Tier 3, « Adaptive ready », est le seul obligatoire : l’application doit occuper tout l’écran sans bandes noires ni mode de compatibilité, fonctionner en multifenêtre et conserver son état (position de défilement, texte saisi, lecture vidéo) lors d’un pliage, d’une rotation ou d'un redimensionnement.
Les sanctions sont nettes : une application hors des clous ne pourra plus être publiée ni recevoir de mise à jour, et pourrait perdre en visibilité. Les applications existantes non mises à jour resteront toutefois téléchargeables. Le couperet touche donc surtout les éditeurs actifs, pas le catalogue dormant.

Este jueves 19 de noviembre, las redes sociales se llenan de saludos y memes por el Día Internacional del Hombre. Algunas publicaciones celebran a padres, amigos y compañeros; otras ironizan sobre lo poco conocida que resulta la fecha o sobre cómo muchos se enteran de que existe cuando ven una imagen compartida en Instagram, Facebook o WhatsApp.
El humor suele apoyarse en situaciones cotidianas: el amigo que recibe una felicitación inesperada, el grupo que pregunta si de verdad “hay un día del hombre” o quien responde con un meme al saludo. También circulan bromas sobre el contraste con otras fechas conmemorativas.

La fecha busca destacar modelos masculinos positivos, reconocer las contribuciones de los hombres y los niños y poner atención en temas como la salud física y emocional. articles.title: Researcher Demonstrates Database RCE Exploits Affecting PostgreSQL, MySQL and Oracle
articles.summary:
Low-privilege database accounts that cannot read a single application table can still be used to run code on the database server itself, a researcher has shown, by reaching memory-corruption bugs in the engine code behind ordinary SQL.
The exploits, published yesterday, are the researcher's proofs of concept against PostgreSQL, MySQL and ClickHouse, plus a separate Oracle chain that needs no login. None has been seen in a real attack.
The work is by Zheng Yu, a researcher at Depthfirst. A database account's SQL permissions control which tables and schemas it can access, the researcher argues, not the memory-unsafe C and C++ code the engine runs to read, plan, and execute a query.
Common grants give an account enough room to reach that code. PostgreSQL's default TEMPORARY privilege, or the right to create temporary tables in MySQL and ClickHouse, allows an account to create objects or send input that triggers a memory bug.
All five flaws now have vendor fixes, four of them with CVEs, but the full attack chains were not reproduced independently, and the research reports no sign that any of them has been used in an attack.
In PostgreSQL, the flaw CVE-2026-116331 allows an account that can create database objects to run code as the operating system user that runs the database.
It was fixed last week in a security advisory, and the CVE record credits the researcher for the report. The researcher's technical analysis shows a plain login role building the objects it needs in its own…

articles.title: Ruby Releases Fixes for 7 Regex and String Flaws, Warns 5 Have Proof-of-Concept RCE
articles.summary:
Ruby contains seven memory-safety flaws in its regular expression engine and its string case-conversion code. For five of them, its maintainers say, proof-of-concept exploits, or PoCs, have shown that crafted input can run code on the machine.
"We are aware of PoCs that prove some of them can be used to trigger remote code execution," the maintainers said.
The project released fixed versions yesterday: Ruby 4.0.10, 3.4.13 and 3.3.14. Whether an application is at risk depends on whether an attacker can get crafted patterns or strings into the affected code, and the advisories report no attacks so far.
The other two flaws are weaker. The maintainers say one has proof-of-concept code that corrupts memory under an attacker's control but has not been shown to run code, and the other can only read memory it should not or crash the program.
The project set the seven out in a security announcement and a separate advisory for each. The advisories rate three flaws critical, three high, and one moderate, and say which carry the remote-code-execution PoCs. In order of severity:
- Critical. GHSA-34m4-m9fh-gqp5, a one-byte heap overflow when Ruby changes the case of a string in certain single-byte encodings, such as ISO-8859-1 or Windows-1252. It has a remote-code-execution PoC. (GitHub advisory)
- Critical. GHSA-7x2q-68qv-6p8x, a double free when Ruby compiles a crafted regular expression that uses a character-class intersection (&&). It has a remote-code-execution PoC. (GitHub advisory)

articles.title: Científicos de Australia mantuvieron vivo un hígado humano fuera del cuerpo durante siete semanas: qué tecnología usaron
articles.summary:
Un equipo de cirujanos de Sídney mantuvo vivo un hígado humano donado durante siete semanas fuera del cuerpo, conectado a una máquina que lo alimentaba y aportaba sangre. Lo afirma el cirujano Carlo Pulitano, del hospital Royal Prince Alfred; los detalles del trabajo aún esperan su publicación.
Pulitano, profesor de la Universidad de Sídney, dijo a MIT Technology Review que el sistema funciona como “un cuerpo artificial”. Se llama Sistema de Perfusión de Órganos Extendida (Extended Organ Perfusion System) y combina bombas automáticas y sensores que aportan nutrientes y sangre y retiran los desechos. El hígado se mantuvo a temperatura corporal, unos 37 °C (98,6 °F).
Un resumen científico del equipo, publicado en el programa del congreso de trasplantes TTS 2026, da cifras más precisas. Con el sistema se conectaron ocho hígados donados enteros, después de otros ocho usados para desarrollar el método. Todos se recuperaron del daño inicial en 24 a 48 horas y el que más duró llegó a 47 días.
Según el mismo resumen, el análisis del tejido mostró que el órgano conservó su estructura, aunque en sus células se formaron mitocondrias gigantes, las estructuras que producen la energía celular.
El récord anterior era de unos 14 días
MIT Technology Review informó que la marca previa para un órgano interno fuera del cuerpo la había fijado hace varios años un equipo de Suiza, también con un hígado, que duró cerca de dos semanas. La mayoría de los órganos para trasplante resiste solo unas horas…

articles.title: Everything Is a Web Application, Including Your Firewall
articles.summary:
One of the early targets of PHP2Shell exploitation was the firewall. On October 28, Palo Alto Networks confirmed that attackers were exploiting the two PHP vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, against PAN-OS management interfaces exposed to the internet. Both flaws let anyone execute code on the web server without authentication. The disclosure itself went a little wrong. Details leaked on October 20, ahead of the coordinated release, and the PHP project shipped an emergency patch the next day.
The vulnerabilities require no authentication, but they are not easy to exploit reliably. It takes skill and additional knowledge about the target system. Where it matters a lot is appliances, which run identical, often outdated software that an attacker can study in advance. That is the bigger picture. An awful lot of web applications control critical devices in your network. Almost anything is a web application to some extent. That often goes unrecognized, and as a result those applications aren't adequately protected.
Everything is a web application. That is the motto of the SANS course I teach, SEC522: Application Security: Securing Web Applications, APIs, and Microservices. Web application security has traditionally been treated as a developer issue, yet anyone protecting a network must understand how web applications work to properly defend them.

articles.summary:
Under specific conditions, a critical vulnerability in Drupal core can allow an attacker without login credentials to use the built-in installer to attempt to reinstall a site.
That can lead to a site takeover or remote code execution, and the project rates the vulnerable configurations as uncommon. Fixed releases for all supported branches shipped yesterday.
The Drupal Security Team disclosed the flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-132165, yesterday and rated it critical, 18 out of 25 on the project's risk scale.
The installer ships in every copy of Drupal core as the file /core/install.php and stays on the site after installation. Core's default .htaccess rules do not block requests to it, so blocking it is left to each site.
No attacks are reported in the security advisory, which rates exploitation as complex and records an existing proof-of-concept exploit. Some exploit paths are blocked where the web server cannot write to or change permissions on settings.php.
The team had told site owners in an advance notice earlier this week to set aside time for the update, warning that exploits may be developed within hours or days.
Every release below 10.6.22 is affected, along with Drupal 11 releases from 11.0.0 before 11.3.22 and from 11.4.0 before 11.4.13.
What to Do Now

articles.title: GTA 6 tiene una isla secreta de perros: qué es, cómo ir y qué recompensas esconde
articles.summary:
GTA 6 tiene escondido uno de los secretos mejor logrados de su mundo abierto: una isla a la que solo se puede llegar rescatado por un perro. El hallazgo, bautizado por los jugadores como la ‘Isla de los Perros’, se suma a una tendencia reciente de videojuegos que permiten acariciar animales, pero lleva la idea a un extremo que no tiene precedentes en la saga.
La secuencia combina un guiño satírico al propio juego con una recompensa jugable real. No es un simple adorno visual: incluye un personaje con el que interactuar, un trayecto en moto de agua y un destino con varias razas caninas y tesoros escondidos en la arena.
Cómo llegar a la isla secreta de perros en GTA 6
Para acceder a este contenido oculto, el primer paso es quedar varado en el agua. El jugador debe ser rescatado por el mejor amigo del hombre, lo que obliga a naufragar en un punto exacto del mapa.

| Branch | Affected releases | Fixed release | 
|---|---|---|
| PHP 8.2 | Before 8.2.36 | 8.2.36 | 
| PHP 8.3 | Before 8.3.37 | 8.3.37 | 
| PHP 8.4 | Before 8.4.28 | 8.4.28 | 
| PHP 8.5 | Before 8.5.13 | 8.5.13 |

articles.title: El juego que ninguna computadora común puede ganar siempre: el chip cuántico de Google acertó 98 de cada 100 veces
articles.summary:
Google publicó este jueves en la revista Science un experimento con un juego que, por una razón matemática, nadie puede ganar siempre. Su chip cuántico Willow acertó el 98,3% de las veces. Con cualquier método tradicional, el máximo posible es el 88,9%.
El dato importa por lo que prueba. Pasar ese límite solo es posible si la máquina funciona con las reglas de la física cuántica. El juego sirve entonces como examen: muestra si un chip es cuántico en los hechos, y cuánto.
Entre los autores figura el premio Nobel de Física 2025 Michel Devoret. El trabajo circulaba desde diciembre de 2025 como borrador en arXiv, el archivo en línea donde los físicos comparten sus resultados antes de que otros científicos los revisen.
Un acertijo que se puede probar en casa
El punto de partida es un acertijo. Hay que dibujar una cuadrícula de tres por tres y llenar cada casilla con +1 o -1. Los números de cada fila, multiplicados, tienen que dar +1. Los de cada columna, -1.
No tiene solución. Las filas exigen que en toda la cuadrícula haya una cantidad par de -1, y las columnas, una cantidad impar. Las dos cosas no pueden ser ciertas a la vez.
“Parece un juego de sudoku. ¡Inténtenlo! Es imposible de hacer”, desafió Rodrigo Cortiñas, investigador vinculado a Google Quantum AI y al Yale Quantum Institute, especializado en información cuántica, física atómica y circuitos superconductores, en diálogo con Infobae. The findings from JobAssist, suggest the current overreliance on AI filtering by HR departments and hiring agencies could have run its course, as the speed of rejections indicates that no humans have reviewed the applications.
While the obvious strategy might be to revise the application or resume to ensure “AI friendly” terms are included, this is an additional time sink for people already under pressure to find work. Without information about how applications are assessed by AI, that whole process could be meaningless – suggesting that the human resources industry could be at a crossroads, forced into making a choice between automation and flesh-and-blood decision making.

articles.title: Microsoft cerrará la app To Do en junio de 2027 y los usuarios de cuentas personales deberán buscar otra
articles.summary:
Microsoft retirará To Do, su aplicación de listas de tareas, el 30 de junio de 2027 en todas sus versiones: Windows, Mac, iPhone, Android y la web. Lo informó en su documentación de soporte, donde advierte que quienes usan cuentas personales tendrán que elegir otra aplicación.
Para las cuentas de trabajo o de escuela, el reemplazo será Microsoft Planner, la herramienta de la empresa para gestionar tareas propias junto con las asignadas por un equipo.
Las listas y tareas existentes no se migrarán a Planner. Seguirán visibles allí hasta el 30 de junio de 2027; después, el usuario ya no podrá verlas ni administrarlas. Microsoft aclaró que el cierre de las aplicaciones no programa por sí solo el borrado de los datos.
El servicio de fondo de To Do, sus interfaces de programación y la sincronización se retirarán más adelante, en fechas que la compañía comunicará por separado. También actualizará los accesos a To Do dentro de Microsoft 365 y dará detalles después.
Planner no admite cuentas personales
Planner no está disponible para cuentas personales, incluidas las de Microsoft 365 Personal y Familia. A esos usuarios, la empresa les indica que revisen sus listas, elijan otra aplicación y esperen las instrucciones para exportar sus datos.

articles.title: Hackers slipped malware into a German drone maker's software update
articles.summary:
Hackers try to plant malware into Ukraine-bound drones — Germany's Quantum Systems says there's 'no risk' after cyberattack failed
German drone maker Quantum Systems suffers major cyberattack
- Hackers disguised malicious code as a legitimate Qbase software update
- The intrusion reportedly reached several customer servers, including Bundeswehr systems
- Security checks detected the package before it reached the aircraft
German drone manufacturer Quantum Systems has confirmed a cyberattack in which unidentified hackers attempted to introduce malicious software into its update distribution system.
The intruders reportedly infiltrated the company's corporate network and inserted harmful code into an internal server, disguising it as a legitimate Qbase software update.
According to Der Spiegel, the compromised platform supports flight planning for Vector reconnaissance aircraft supplied to Ukraine and Germany.
Hackers target software used by military reconnaissance drones
Ukraine uses these aircraft for military reconnaissance, while the German armed forces operate them under the name Falke.
The malicious package reportedly spread to Bundeswehr servers and other customer systems, where security inspections detected it.
The malicious code was reportedly disguised as a software update, potentially allowing compromised installations to receive unauthorized instructions.

Estas funciones permiten armar itinerarios, aprovechar información ya guardada en el correo electrónico, localizar sitios marcados previamente y ajustar los planes sobre la marcha sin rehacer todo el recorrido.

La función Ask Maps permite generar un plan de viaje completo a partir de una solicitud en lenguaje natural. En lugar de entregar una lista extensa de lugares para visitar, organiza las sugerencias en un itinerario dividido por jornadas, con las ubicaciones marcadas directamente en el mapa.
Esto resulta útil cuando un viaje debe combinar distintos elementos en pocos días: reservas de hotel, traslados en tren, recorridos turísticos y actividades pensadas para los integrantes más jóvenes del grupo.

- New strategy shifts attention from interception toward earlier detection and coordinated responses
- Autonomous systems are becoming central to the Air Force's future combat planning
The US Air Force has introduced a new modernization plan that focuses on advanced sensors, artificial intelligence and autonomous systems to counter increasingly advanced aerial threats.
Its new Force Design 2026 changes how the service plans to defend against air attacks and prepare for future wars.
The approach prioritizes finding and tracking threats early and coordinating responses, rather than depending mainly on weapons that intercept and destroy incoming aircraft or drones.
New strategy prioritizes sensors, AI, and networked warfare
The updated framework identifies sensors, interconnected networks and artificial intelligence as technologies increasingly influencing modern air defense operations.
These capabilities could help military forces identify incoming threats, coordinate defensive responses and manage multiple unmanned aircraft operating simultaneously.
Air Force officials also acknowledge that technological developments are creating difficulties for traditional approaches to generating military airpower.
